Impacted Systems: Western Digital MyCloud Networked Attached Storage (NAS) devices
Method of Attack: Authentication bypass by modifying cookie session parameters
Remote code execution by embedding shell commands in cookie parameters
Exploitation via malicious code inside image tags on websites visited by MyCloud NAS owners
Remote command execution with root privileges allowing full control and data upload/download
Attack Vector: Embedding shell commands in cookie parameters
Embedding malicious code in image tags on websites visited by users
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept exploit code available on Exploitee.rs wiki
Use of image tags with local IP of NAS in websites
